segments.sub: What if the Sun disappeared... for ten seconds?
segments.tts: What if the Sun disappeared... for ten seconds?

segments.sub: Here's the crazy part. For eight minutes... nothing happens.
segments.tts: Here's the crazy part. For eight minutes... nothing happens.

segments.sub: Sunlight takes eight minutes and twenty seconds to reach us. So we'd keep seeing a Sun that isn't there anymore.
segments.tts: Sunlight takes eight minutes and twenty seconds to reach us. So we'd keep seeing a Sun that isn't there anymore.

segments.sub: Even gravity travels at the speed of light. So the Earth keeps going around... nothing.
segments.tts: Even gravity travels at the speed of light. So the Earth keeps going around... nothing.

segments.sub: Ten seconds of total night, in the middle of the day. Even the Moon goes dark, because it only reflects sunlight.
segments.tts: Ten seconds of total night, in the middle of the day. Even the Moon goes dark, because it only reflects sunlight.

segments.sub: Meanwhile, the Earth flies off in a straight line, three hundred kilometers.
segments.tts: Meanwhile, the Earth flies off in a straight line, three hundred kilometers.

segments.sub: Then the light and the gravity come back, and everything returns to normal.
segments.tts: Then the light and the gravity come back, and everything returns to normal.

segments.sub: Except for a lot of very confused animals.
